name: p4-delete-piston-base
notes: P4 (corrupt-events): retract-delete aimed at an extended piston's BASE. Victim V at (0,2,0) faces east, powered by the redstone block behind it, head at (1,2,0). Swap piston SP at (0,3,0) faces up, torch-powered from (0,3,1). Chord: break torch, break SP, place piston facing down: the queued retract deletes V. Pass requires BOTH the base cell and the head cell empty of minecraft:piston* (target_block is a prefix on the bridge): the orphan head must collapse in the same update (PistonHeadBlock.updateShape), i.e. no survival headless piston by this route.
